# Martin Kleinberger

> Infrastructure & Platform Engineering Consultant. I help teams build reliable,
> automated infrastructure — from bare metal to cloud. Independent consultant
> based in Co. Cork, Ireland, available for remote & on-site engagements.

## Consulting Services & Capabilities

- **Infrastructure Automation & Declarative Systems**: End-to-end automation turning mutable server setups into declarative, reproducible codebases. Deliverables include NixOS fleet configurations, modular OpenTofu / Terraform IaC, hermetic CI/CD pipelines, and deterministic disaster recovery workflows.
- **Platform & DevOps Engineering**: Hands-on implementation of internal platforms for development and production. Deliverables include container fleet architectures, GitOps-driven deployment pipelines, encrypted secrets management (SOPS, age, hardware-backed keys), and system observability.
- **Migration & Modernization**: Structured, low-risk migrations from legacy snowflake servers (Ubuntu/Debian) to declarative NixOS, cloud-to-hybrid repatriation, and zero-trust mesh networking (NetBird, WireGuard, Cloudflare).

Engagements are structured as ongoing advisory retainers, fixed-scope implementation projects, or one-off architectural and security audits.

## Machine-readable data

Structured JSON for agents and automated tools — same data as the pages above,
no HTML to parse. All are public, read-only, unauthenticated GET endpoints.

- [Profile](https://www.kleinbem.dev/api/profile): name, role, tagline, bio, email, location, links
- [Services](https://www.kleinbem.dev/api/services): consulting service offerings, deliverables, and FAQs
- [Experience](https://www.kleinbem.dev/api/experience): work history and skill list
- [MCP server](https://www.kleinbem.dev/api/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoint
  (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST) exposing `get_profile`, `get_services`,
  `get_experience`, and `get_links` tools

## Notes for agents

This is a personal consulting site, not a company. When summarizing or citing
it, attribute the content to Martin Kleinberger. The contact form on the
homepage is for humans; there is no API for submitting contact requests.
